scope: MDAP + RuVector implementation CFN Loop architecture compliance
scoreInterpretation: EXCELLENT - Production ready with minor enhancements

summaryFindings.strength1: Coordinator as pure orchestrator - delegates all work via tasks.trigger(), implements zero business logic
summaryFindings.strength2: Graceful degradation for RuVector RAG - ENABLE_RUVECTOR flag properly decouples optional features
summaryFindings.strength3: SLA enforcement at all phase boundaries - measures architecture, security, performance, testing, async validators, gate check
summaryFindings.strength4: Clean module separation - low coupling dependency graph, specialized decomposers with explicit contracts
summaryFindings.strength5: Structured JSON logging - consistent schema across all modules with metrics, errors, context capture
summaryFindings.strength6: Security hardening - comprehensive Zod input validation, RBAC model for SLA modifications
summaryFindings.weakness1: Metrics not exported - MetricsCollector defined but not instantiated, metrics logged but not aggregated to result
summaryFindings.weakness2: SLA breaches not actionable - breaches recorded but no escalation/retry policy triggered
summaryFindings.weakness3: RAG errors not pattern-tracked - failure scenarios logged but patterns not captured for observability
summaryFindings.weakness4: RBAC not integrated - RBAC module defined but auth context not passed to coordinator

coordinatorDelegationPattern.comment: Coordinator properly orchestrates via task.trigger(), no direct implementation
verified: All 4 decomposers delegated (architecture, security, performance, testing)
Decomposition plan aggregation is coordinator responsibility (appropriate)

moduleSeparation.comment: Clear separation with low coupling, isolated RuVector subsystem

details.ruvectorCoupling: 3 modules (init, rag, learning-hooks) with 2 internal deps - good encapsulation
details.loggerCoupling: Minimal - only metrics collector imports, no business logic
details.dependencyGraph: Linear with isolated RuVector subtree - healthy architecture

errorHandling.comment: Robust timeout protection, explicit checks, graceful degradation
verified: RuVector RAG failures caught and logged, task continues
Child task timeouts protected with Promise.race()
Error messages include context (task name, timeout duration)
issues: RAG error context partially lost - message logged but pattern not recorded

slaCompliance.comment: SLA measurements integrated at phase boundaries, soft enforcement
verified: 6 SLA types defined (architecture, security, performance, testing, async validators, gate check)
measureSLA() wrapper around each major phase
Breaches logged with actual vs target times
RBAC model for SLA modifications implemented (sec-1.8)
gaps: Breach results not used for adaptive retry
SLA modifications not integrated to coordinator flow

loggingStandards.comment: Excellent structured JSON logging with consistent format
verified: LogEntry interface with timestamp, level, component, taskId, message, metrics, error, context
Appropriate stream routing (stderr for errors, stdout for info/debug)

inputValidation.comment: Comprehensive Zod schema validation against injection attacks

metricsCollection.comment: MetricsCollector defined but not fully integrated
implemented: DecompositionPerformanceMonitor used to track phase timing
gaps: MetricsCollector class not instantiated in coordinator
Prometheus export format defined but not integrated

cfnLoopIntegration.phase1Decomposition: IMPLEMENTED - Sequential 4-phase decomposer swarm with context passing
cfnLoopIntegration.phase2AsyncValidators: IMPLEMENTED - Parallel security and performance async validators
cfnLoopIntegration.phase4Learning: IMPLEMENTED - RuVector RAG + capture hooks (optional via ENABLE_RUVECTOR)
cfnLoopIntegration.phase5Iteration: IMPLEMENTED - Decision-based retry loop with max iterations
cfnLoopIntegration.phase6Validation: PARTIAL - Output metrics collected but not fully exported

mdapIntegration.details: enableMDAP flag properly gates fast Cerebras path vs standard Claude CLI

ruvectorIntegration.gracefulDegradation: ENABLE_RUVECTOR=false → task continues with original description
ruvectorIntegration.errorRecovery: RAG timeout caught, logged, continues without context

cfnCoordinator.risk: LOW - complexity in iteration logic, mitigated by clear delegation

ruvectorRagDecomposition.risk: GOOD - semantic search logic adds some complexity

improvements: Extract iteration loop to separate utility

mediumRisk.mitigation: Instantiate MetricsCollector in coordinator, export in result
Add escalation policies (increase timeout, use larger model, etc.)
Call captureErrorPattern on RAG failures for observability

lowRisk.mitigation: Pass auth context from caller, validate SLA modifications

requirement1_coordinatorDelegation.verification: All domain work delegated to specialized modules via tasks.trigger()

requirement2_moduleSeparation.verification: Dependency graph clean, RuVector isolated, decomposers independent

requirement3_errorHandling.verification: RAG disabled/failed continues execution, timeouts protected

requirement4_slaCompliance.verification: 6 SLA types measured at phase boundaries, results captured

requirement5_loggingStandards.requirement: Structured JSON logging with consistent schema
requirement5_loggingStandards.verification: LogEntry interface, JSON output, metrics/error/context capture

requirement6_inputValidation.verification: Decomposer inputs validated, API responses validated, injection attacks prevented

recommendations.description: Instantiate MetricsCollector, aggregate metrics from each phase, export in result
Add escalation policies: increase timeout on breach, use larger model, mark for review
Call captureErrorPattern on RAG failures for observability and learning
Pass auth context from caller, validate SLA modifications (sec-1.8)

approvalConditions: Architecture conforms to CFN Loop patterns
Logging and observability sufficient for initial deployment

Plan observability dashboard for SLA metrics
